blurb: Apple Wallet stores supported passes, keys, IDs, and cards using device-bound credentials and authentication policies appropriate to each item. Access credentials can use the Secure Element, NFC, Bluetooth, Ultra Wideband, or device-to-reader protocols, with Face ID, Touch ID, Optic ID, or a passcode required where appropriate. For IDs, Wallet supports selective disclosure and encrypted presentation sessions so a reader can request only needed attributes. Apple designs these flows to reduce unnecessary sharing while keeping credentials difficult to clone or replay.
